verdict.rationale: Mailgun's docs explicitly promise a two-minute sandbox-domain quickstart and provide SDKs across multiple languages, and developer community testimonials corroborate that integration is fast and low-friction compared to competitors. However, some real-world friction (e.g., DNS/domain validation dashboard issues reported by a free-tier user) shows setup isn't always fully self-explanatory for production use beyond the sandbox quickstart. Missing for 10: explicit copy-paste code snippets per language, independent hands-on account confirming zero hidden steps end-to-end.
